task_completion.description: Enable Developer Mode in the Odoo settings or via the URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The presence of the 'bug' icon in the top navigation bar or 'Developer Mode' active in the Settings dashboard.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Activity Types configuration menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The breadcrumb or page header shows 'Settings / Activity Types' or 'Configuration / Activity Types'.

task_completion.description: Set the Activity Type name to 'Product Demo' and constrain it to the 'Lead/Opportunity' model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field contains 'Product Demo' and the 'Model' or 'Constrain to Model' field shows 'Lead/Opportunity' (crm.lead).

task_completion.description: Configure the default summary and the 'Planned in' delay.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Default Summary' field contains 'Scheduled product demonstration' and the 'Planned in' field is set to '3' days.

task_completion.description: Configure the default note with the specific instruction text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Default Note' text area contains 'Please prepare the demo environment and confirm attendee list before the session.'

task_completion.description: Save the newly created Activity Type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button is clicked, or the form enters read-only mode with the 'Product Demo' title visible at the top.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database queries or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields, dropdowns, and buttons within the Odoo web interface.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than just jumping to a final success URL (unless enabling dev mode).
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequence of screenshots showing the Settings menu or Configuration menus being opened.

integrity.description: The agent typed or pasted the specific strings required by the task into the actual UI fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the specific text 'Product Demo' and the note fragment 'prepare the demo environment' being entered into the Odoo form.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The activity type must be named 'Product Demo'. The default summary is 'Scheduled product demonstration'. The default note must be 'Please prepare the demo environment and confirm attendee list before the session.' The 'Planned in' field must be 3. The model must be 'Lead/Opportunity' (technical name: crm.lead). Developer mode must be active to see technical model constraints in some Odoo versions.
